dishes.name: Pani Puri
dishes.description: Six crisp semolina shells served with spiced mint-coriander water (teekha pani), sweet tamarind-jaggery chutney, mashed potato and boiled chickpeas. Assembled and eaten one bite at a time. Spice and sweetness of the water can be set per guest.

dishes.name: Veg Samosa
dishes.description: Two hand-folded triangular pastries filled with spiced mashed potato, green peas and whole spices, deep-fried till golden. Served with mint chutney and tamarind chutney.

dishes.name: Samosa Chaat
dishes.description: A samosa broken and smothered with warm white-pea ragda, whisked yogurt, tamarind and mint chutney, onions, sev and chaat masala.

dishes.name: Pav Bhaji
dishes.description: A rich mash of potato, tomato, peas and capsicum cooked with pav-bhaji masala and finished with butter, served with two soft pav toasted in butter, chopped onion and lemon.

dishes.name: Mixed Veg Pakora
dishes.description: Onion, potato and spinach dipped in spiced besan (gram flour) batter and fried crisp. Served with mint chutney. Naturally gluten-free batter.

dishes.name: Khaman Dhokla
dishes.description: Light, spongy steamed cakes of fermented gram flour, topped with a tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli, finished with sugar-lemon water and coriander. Steamed, not fried.

dishes.name: Masala Dosa
dishes.description: A large, crisp fermented rice-and-lentil crepe wrapped around a spiced potato filling, served with sambar and coconut & tomato chutneys. Cooked on a griddle.

dishes.name: Plain Sada Dosa
dishes.description: The same crisp fermented crepe as the masala dosa but without the potato filling — lighter, served with sambar and chutneys.

dishes.name: Idli Sambar
dishes.description: Three soft steamed cakes of fermented rice and urad lentil, served with sambar and coconut chutney. Light, oil-free and easy to digest.

dishes.name: Dal Makhani
dishes.description: Whole black urad lentils and kidney beans simmered overnight, finished with butter, cream and tomato. Rich and mildly spiced. Best with naan or rice.

dishes.name: Dal Tadka
dishes.description: Toor and moong lentils cooked soft and finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee, cumin, garlic, dried chilli and tomato. Lighter than dal makhani.

dishes.name: Kadai Paneer
dishes.description: Cubes of paneer tossed with onion, capsicum and tomato in a freshly ground coriander-pepper kadai masala. Semi-dry and aromatic.

dishes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
dishes.description: Soft paneer in a smooth makhani gravy of tomato, butter, cream and cashew, mildly sweet and rich. The crowd-pleaser, very mild.

dishes.name: Chole Bhature
dishes.description: A robust, tangy chickpea curry (chole) served with two large, deep-fried leavened breads (bhature), with onion, pickle and green chilli.

dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
dishes.description: Long-grain basmati rice dum-cooked in layers with yogurt-marinated chicken, fried onions, mint and saffron. Served with raita and salan.

dishes.name: Veg Dum Biryani
dishes.description: Basmati rice dum-cooked with carrot, beans, paneer and potato in biryani masala with fried onions and mint. Served with raita.

dishes.name: Veg Fried Rice
dishes.description: Day-cooked rice stir-fried on high heat with carrot, beans, cabbage, spring onion, soy and a touch of vinegar. Indo-Chinese style.

dishes.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
dishes.description: Veg fried rice fired up with house schezwan sauce — hot, garlicky and tangy. A Gen-Z favourite.

dishes.name: Steamed Veg Momos
dishes.description: Six hand-pleated flour dumplings filled with finely chopped cabbage, carrot and spring onion, steamed and served with fiery red momo chutney.

dishes.name: Paneer Momos
dishes.description: Soft steamed dumplings stuffed with grated paneer, onion and pepper, served with red momo chutney.

dishes.name: Veg Manchurian (Dry)
dishes.description: Deep-fried cabbage-carrot dumplings tossed in a glossy soy-garlic-chilli sauce with onion and capsicum. Served dry as a starter.

dishes.name: Chilli Paneer (Dry)
dishes.description: Batter-fried paneer cubes wok-tossed with onion, capsicum, green chilli and a soy-chilli sauce. A Gen-Z starter favourite.

dishes.name: Hakka Noodles (Veg)
dishes.description: Boiled wheat noodles wok-tossed with julienned vegetables, soy and pepper. Light, smoky and quick.

dishes.name: Chicken Kathi Roll
dishes.description: Flaky paratha coated with egg, filled with spiced grilled chicken, onions, green chutney and a squeeze of lemon, rolled to order.

dishes.name: Paneer Kathi Roll
dishes.description: Paratha filled with marinated paneer tikka, onions, capsicum and mint chutney, rolled to order. Vegetarian version of the kathi roll.

dishes.name: Butter Naan
dishes.description: A pillowy refined-flour flatbread baked in the tandoor and brushed with butter. Pairs with any gravy.

dishes.name: Garlic Naan
dishes.description: Soft naan studded with chopped garlic and coriander, brushed with butter. Fragrant and a Gen-Z pairing favourite.

dishes.name: Tandoori Roti
dishes.description: A rustic whole-wheat flatbread baked crisp on the tandoor walls. Lower in fat than naan and dairy-free if served plain.

dishes.name: Margherita Pizza
dishes.description: Hand-stretched thin crust topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and fresh basil, baked in a deck oven. 8 inch.

dishes.name: Paneer Tikka Pizza
dishes.description: Thin-crust pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, tandoori-spiced paneer tikka, onion and capsicum — an Indo-Italian Gen-Z favourite.

dishes.name: Classic Veg Burger
dishes.description: A toasted bun layered with a crisp potato-veg patty, lettuce, tomato, onion and creamy mayo. Served with a side of fries portion is separate.

customisations.customisation: Sesame-free bun (Only sesame buns are stocked currently.)

dishes.name: Crispy Chicken Burger
dishes.description: A juicy crumb-fried chicken fillet with lettuce, onion and spicy mayo in a toasted sesame bun.

dishes.name: Peri Peri Fries
dishes.description: Golden potato fries dusted with house peri peri spice mix, served with a mayo dip. A Gen-Z snack staple.

dishes.name: Penne Alfredo Pasta
dishes.description: Penne tossed in a creamy white sauce of butter, milk, cheese and garlic, finished with herbs and chilli flakes. Veg.

dishes.name: Masala Chai
dishes.description: Black tea simmered with milk, sugar, ginger and cardamom. Served hot in a cup.

dishes.name: Cold Coffee
dishes.description: Instant coffee blended with cold milk, sugar and a scoop of vanilla ice cream, topped with chocolate syrup. Thick and frothy.

dishes.name: Sweet Lassi
dishes.description: Thick whisked yogurt blended with sugar and a hint of cardamom, served chilled. Cooling and probiotic.

dishes.name: Mango Lassi
dishes.description: Thick yogurt blended with ripe mango pulp and a little sugar, served chilled. Seasonal favourite, mildly sweet.

dishes.name: Malai Kulfi
dishes.description: Traditional kulfi made from reduced milk (rabri) flavoured with cardamom and topped with chopped pistachio and almond. Denser than ice cream.

dishes.name: Jalebi
dishes.description: Fermented flour batter piped into spirals, deep-fried crisp and dunked in warm saffron-cardamom sugar syrup. Served hot.
